about.body: I am a software developer and a Systems Analysis and Development student at Faculdade Impacta. I work in back-end development using Java and Spring Boot, and I take part in building Ayni, a technology startup. I have a special interest in artificial intelligence, autonomous agents, and automation, areas I continuously study to explore new ways of building smarter and more useful systems. I enjoy understanding technology beyond the code, from system architecture to the possibilities of turning an idea into a real product.
about.lookingFor: Back-end developer opportunities (Java/Spring), freelance projects with well-defined scope and teams that value clean code and good practices.
